title: Removing the entry with the empty key from a single-pair mapping in a flow sequence
notes: A pointer token matches a key by its scalar text, and a key with no content has the empty text, so `/0/` names the entry `: 0`. Removing the only entry leaves an empty mapping, written `{}` (the same rule as edit/remove-last-entry-of-flow-single-pair). The convention is that an empty key is addressed by the empty token. The input is valid: yaml-test-suite CFD4 reads `[: x]` as a mapping with one empty key.

provenance.reference: A writer that removed the value and left `[:0]`, which reads as the string `:0`.
